query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
# This workflow builds PCGen with Gradle. The `build` and `integration-tests`
# jobs run in parallel — they share the Gradle build cache via setup-gradle@v6
# but otherwise compile their inputs independently. Splitting the previous
# single-job sequence (`./gradlew build` then `./gradlew itest datatest slowtest`)
# shaves the ~4 min compile/spotbugs/unit-test phase off the critical path of
# the ~16 min slow-test phase.

name: Build PCGen with Gradle

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build, unit tests, and static analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      checks: write
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up JDK 25
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version: '25'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      # setup-gradle@v6 is the canonical Gradle cache for GitHub Actions.
      # See: https://github.com/gradle/actions/blob/main/setup-gradle/README.md
      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6

      - name: Build with Gradle Wrapper
        run: ./gradlew build --stacktrace

      - name: Publish Unit Test Results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          check_name: 'Unit Test Results'
          files: |
            build/test-results/test/**/*.xml
            base/build/test-results/**/*.xml
            formula/build/test-results/**/*.xml

      - name: Run Coverage
        run: ./gradlew testCoverage --stacktrace

      - name: Upload Report to artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: testCoverage
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/build/reports/jacoco/testCoverage/html

      - name: Jacoco Report to PR
        id: jacoco
        uses: madrapps/jacoco-report@v1.8.0
        with:
          paths: |
            ${{ github.workspace }}/build/reports/jacoco/testCoverage/testCoverage.xml
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          title: '## :construction: PCGen Code Coverage'
          update-comment: true
          debug-mode: false

      - name: Get the Coverage info
        run: |
          echo "Total coverage ${{ steps.jacoco.outputs.coverage-overall }}"
          echo "Changed Files coverage ${{ steps.jacoco.outputs.coverage-changed-files }}"

  integration-tests:
    name: Integration, data, and slow tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      checks: write
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up JDK 25
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          java-version: '25'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v6

      - name: Run integration, data, and slow tests
        run: ./gradlew itest datatest slowtest --stacktrace

      - name: Publish Integration Test Results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          check_name: 'Integration Test Results'
          files: |
            build/test-results/itest/**/*.xml
            build/test-results/slowtest/**/*.xml

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
